explication: Impactor is a cross-platform iOS sideloading application. The documented workflow is to authenticate an Apple account, register a device and app with Apple, obtain signing credentials and provisioning, modify and sign the package, then install it on the device. The tree also supports pairing-file/device utilities, automatic refresh, and a separate signing CLI. Several feature paths are documented but their implementation was not sampled, so those relationships are represented only where the README or sampled source supports them.
